checked.id_or_column: Base of Withholding column Y - CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING
checked.reason: Data re-verified: Y > 0 for 20 employees, Y = X - V on all 20, all 20 have AFC (I) or APV (J) > 0, grand total 14,300,634, and no G2N WT carries it. The facts are correct. The classification is the judgement call. Form 350 has no casilla for contingent withholding, and the amount is not practised by the employer in the month, so it is not a field the spec should map. The cross-checker itself says it is 'Missing' only in the sense that the spec must state its treatment. DECIDE: either (a) keep it as 'Missing in spec' and add an explicit exclusion sentence to the casilla 93 Field Explanation, or (b) reclassify it as 'Client-specific' (no Form 350 field) and carry the exclusion only as the DECISION PENDING item (a) already in the row-23 proposed text. Recommendation: (b), with RA confirmation under ET art. 126-1 / 126-4 that contingent withholding is not declared on the employer's Form 350.

The facts are confirmed: Master Data 'Country' holds CO 253, co 2, CA, CR, cr, DO, CH, MX; 15 employees have Nationality different from Country; the 7 Procedure-3 employees in the run have address country co, CR, DO, CH, co, CO, CO. The 'Explanation to improve' verdict is right, because the spec does not say which attribute supplies the country. The proposed text, however, adds a requirement that no cited source supports: 'upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code'. The spec only says Format 'Country code', example 'ES', File Structure '144 Pais + Cod.'. DIAN forms commonly use DIAN's own numeric country-code table, so the code standard must be checked against the Form 350 sheet-2 instruction guide. DECIDE: approve the proposed text with the ISO alpha-2 clause removed or replaced by 'the country code required by the DIAN Form 350 sheet-2 list (to be confirmed by RA)'. The rest (tax-residence country, not Nationality, normalise case, treaty country when CON CONVENIO) is supported.
